question: Should consecutive malformed paired-node pullAudio payloads consume the existing five-error budget and close the Google Meet audio bridge?
rationale: Both fail-closed shutdown and bounded discard are technically viable; choosing the intended availability behavior for an active meeting requires Google Meet owner intent rather than an automated code repair.

options.title: Approve fail-closed cutoff
options.body: Retain the current patch so five consecutive malformed chunks close the bridge, preventing corrupt audio from reaching playback or providers.

options.title: Discard and recover
options.body: Keep validation but handle malformed chunks with a separately bounded warning or corruption policy that does not consume the transport-error shutdown budget.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed cutoff
recommendation.body: Retain the current patch so five consecutive malformed chunks close the bridge, preventing corrupt audio from reaching playback or providers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Meet realtime history shows this account owning and merging adjacent provider, buffering, compatibility, and session-behavior decisions.
